title: Stop Wasting Your Life on Things You Can’t Control
coreMove: When another adult's mood or harmless choice stops being your emergency, your time and energy come back for the things you can actually decide.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Oakley's prom-night taco bar
exampleSpecs.audience: Asha and readers facing control separation
exampleSpecs.stakes: The fastest path back to peace is to let other adults and near-adults own the consequences of harmless choices.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Asha using control separation in the source case without controlling another person.
